attribution: Contains Open Food Facts data (https://world.openfoodfacts.org), licensed under ODbL-1.0.
bucket_note: Curation-aid classification of quantity text by regex; the Swift evaluator (PackageMassParser + CatalogBinder) is the ground truth for outcome counts. Several "mass" records use spelled-out units (e.g. "150 gram").
dataset: Open Food Facts search API extract (fields: code, product_name, brands, quantity, serving_size, ingredients_text)
fetch_command: curl -sS --max-time 90 -A 'FridgeLuck-dev/1.0 (contact: sgu07966@gmail.com)' '<source_url>' -o raw_page_<n>.json (run per URL, 3 s apart)
license: ODbL-1.0 (Open Database License) — contents of the Open Food Facts database are licensed under CC-BY-SA 3.0 for text and ODbL 1.0 for data; see https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/
notes: Page 2 excluded: OFF served an HTML 'Page temporarily unavailable' error page on two attempts (raw_page_2.json kept out of the fixture). 700 unique code+name records from 7 pages; 340 selected deterministically for outcome diversity. OFF carries no price field, so the price-only mass-rejection class is exercised by unit tests on synthetic strings, not by this fixture.
selection: All multipack-mass, serving, serving-size-with-missing-quantity, and missing-quantity records; first-by-code up to 45 volume, 45 count-only, 40 free-text; up to 20 with >=2 catalog-ingredient-token name matches (identity-ambiguity preference); remainder explicit-mass records to reach 340. Sorted by code; no RNG.
